title: 第13章 接取悬赏任务第14章 一千两白银
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
离开坊市，正准备回草药场，刚巧路过‘告示栏’。
告示栏发布一条悬赏：
“宗门下属门派所属饲兽场，多次遭遇残杀，疑有凶兽出没，外门炼气一层弟子前往，一旬未归，遂发布悬赏，初级灵石十颗，相关事宜，请前往外门任务堂了解！”
苏星河第一次听说有，还有任务堂，摸了摸空荡荡的口袋，有些心动。
“这位师兄，请问任务堂怎么走？”
苏星河问身旁一位个头比自己稍高，但修为却只有一层的瘦削弟子询问。
“前方第三个路口，右转，一直走就看到了。”
瘦削弟子本不想理会苏星河，只是稍一感应，发现实力比自己强，立即转变脸色，只是没好意思以师兄自居。
道谢一声，苏星河直奔任务堂。
大堂宽敞，古色古香，几张桌椅错落有序，却是空空荡荡，没几个人，只有正堂桌后，两名身着管事制服的弟子，看到有人前来，露出善意的笑容。
为首管事，发丝微白，额角皱纹明显，竟然是个年迈的老修士，这在外门，苏星河还是一次见到。
“前辈，我要接悬赏任务！”
对方一把年纪，师兄就有些喊不出口，索性以前辈相称。
“师弟看着有些面生，可是看了告示前来？”老者上下打量苏星河，似乎对他来接取任务有些疑惑。
其实也不难理解，苏星河入门才一年，眼下只有十三岁，虽然身高长了不少，依旧是少年模样。
这样刚入门不久的年轻弟子，正是修炼的大好年纪，多数人都在努力提高修为，会来领取悬赏任务的，多数都入门很久，宗门大比实力达不到进入内门的条件，修为又限于天资，很难更近一层，这才会接取悬赏。
完成悬赏，获取灵石，或者积累宗门功勋，兑换灵丹妙药，寻求突破，或者购买法器，通过外物提高自身实力。
而苏星河虽然是刚入门不久，却是限于天赋，修炼进展缓慢，虽然身负一堆宝贝，暂时却帮不上任何忙。
相反，这一次坊市，让苏星河认识到钱的重要性。
“正是，第一次前来领取任务，不知有什么要求？”苏星河虚心求教。

“要求只有一点，达到任务所需实力即可！”
“不知我的实力是否符合？”
苏星河没有自报修为，对方明显比自己强，能轻易判断出自己的修为深浅。
“师弟炼气二层，符合条件，赏金十颗下品灵石，可有异议?”
被一个年纪堪比自己爷爷的老人，一口一个师弟叫着，苏星河有点不适应，但修仙就是如此，年纪只是个数字，一切以实力为尊。
“没有！”
“好，这是任务令牌，凭此可随意出入宗门，另外，我有几点要提醒师弟！”
老者说话时，身旁年轻弟子麻利的递过一块令牌，笑着交到苏星河手里。
“前辈请讲！”
苏星河接过令牌，朝年轻修士点头致意，目光转回老者。
“这悬赏，本来只有5颗下品灵石，现在却提高到10颗，你可知道为何？”老人说话时，嘴角胡须随着晃动，有些滑稽。
“可是因为先前领取任务的弟子，一直未回，任务有些凶险？”苏星河想起告示上有所提及。
“正是，山下凡俗中，能够杀死一层修士，很有可能是头妖兽，所以任务要求提高了修为！”老人神色郑重。
“既然如此，怎么不直接将修为限制到三层，或者更高？”苏星河提出疑惑。
content_en:
After leaving Fangshi, I was about to return to the herbal medicine farm when I happened to pass by the 'Notice Board'.
A reward was posted on the notice board:
"The animal feeding grounds owned by the subordinate sects of the sect have been massacred many times. It is suspected that there are ferocious beasts. Disciples from the first level of Qi Refining of the outer sect went there and did not return for ten days, so they issued a reward of ten primary spiritual stones. For related matters, please go to the mission hall of the outer sect to learn more!"
It was the first time Su Xinghe heard that there was a mission hall. He touched his empty pocket and felt a little excited.
"Senior brother, may I ask how to get to the mission hall?"
Su Xinghe asked a thin disciple next to him who was slightly taller than him but only had one level of cultivation.
"At the third intersection ahead, turn right and keep walking until you see it."
The thin disciple didn't want to pay attention to Su Xinghe at first, but after a moment of sensing, he realized that he was stronger than himself, and immediately changed his expression, but he didn't have the nerve to call himself a senior brother.
After thanking him, Su Xinghe went straight to the mission hall.
The lobby is spacious and antique, with a few tables and chairs scattered in an orderly manner, but it is empty and there are not many people. There are only two disciples in steward uniforms behind the main hall table. When they see someone coming, they smile kindly.
The chief steward, with slightly white hair and obvious wrinkles on his forehead, turned out to be an old monk. This was the first time Su Xinghe had seen him in the outer sect.
"Senior, I want to accept the bounty mission!"
When the other party is older, the senior brother can't say it out loud, so he simply behaves like a senior.
"Junior brother looks a little unfamiliar, but you came here after reading the notice?" The old man looked Su Xinghe up and down, seeming to be a little confused about him coming to accept the mission.
In fact, it is not difficult to understand. Su Xinghe has only been in the industry for a year and is only thirteen years old now. Although he has grown a lot in height, he still looks like a teenager.
Such young disciples who have just entered the school are at a good age for cultivation. Most of them are working hard to improve their cultivation level and will come to receive the bounty mission. Most of them have been in the school for a long time. Their strength in the sect competition cannot meet the conditions for entering the inner sect. Their cultivation level is limited to their talent. It is difficult to get closer to the next level, so they will accept the bounty.
Complete bounties, obtain spiritual stones, or accumulate sect meritorious service, exchange for elixirs, seek breakthroughs, or purchase magic weapons to improve your own strength through external objects.
Although Su Xinghe has just started training, he is limited by his talent and his cultivation progress is slow. Although he has a lot of treasures, he can't be of any help for the time being.
On the contrary, this time the market made Su Xinghe realize the importance of money.
"Exactly, it's my first time here to receive a mission. What are the requirements?" Su Xinghe humbly asked for advice.
"There is only one requirement, just meet the required strength for the task!"
"I wonder if my strength matches it?"
Su Xinghe did not report his own cultivation level. The other party was obviously stronger than him and could easily judge the depth of his own cultivation level.
"Junior brother is on the second level of Qi Refining. If he meets the conditions, he will be rewarded with ten low-grade spiritual stones. Do you have any objections?"
Su Xinghe was a little uncomfortable being called by an old man who was as old as his own grandfather, one after another. However, this is how cultivating immortals is, age is just a number, and everything is based on strength.
"No!"
"Okay, this is a mission token. With this, you can enter and leave the sect at will. In addition, I have a few things to remind my junior brother!"
While the old man was speaking, the young disciple beside him quickly handed over a token and handed it to Su Xinghe's hand with a smile.
"Senior, please speak!"
Su Xinghe took the token, nodded to the young monk, and turned his eyes back to the old man.
"This reward originally only had 5 low-grade spiritual stones, but now it has been increased to 10. Do you know why?" When the old man spoke, his beard swayed at the corners of his mouth, which was a little funny.
"But because the disciple who received the mission previously has never returned, the mission is a bit dangerous?" Su Xinghe remembered what was mentioned in the notice.
"Exactly, among the mortals at the foot of the mountain, anyone who can kill a monk on the first level is most likely a monster, so the mission requires an increase in cultivation!" The old man looked solemn.
"In this case, why not just limit the cultivation level to the third level, or higher?" Su XingheRaise doubts.
